intermediate.name: Ješovec pri Šmarju
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Ješovec pri Šmarju (92.8 km)

story: In Stage 1 of the 2026 Tour of Slovenia, four early breakaway riders quickly established their lead. Bahrain - Victorious and Red Bull - BORA - hansgrohe set a high pace, with Red Bull accelerating on a hill, causing splits in the peloton and catching the breakaway. Most sprinters were dropped. Red Bull secured a 1-2 finish: Pithie first, Marit second.
